Its trailing stems and attractive heart shaped leaves create a relaxed, flowing display that looks lovely in hanging planters, on shelves, or across elevated surfaces. Use it to soften a room, add detail to a workspace, or bring a touch of nature to smaller areas. Its easygoing shape makes it a versatile addition to indoor plant collections.

Its trailing stems naturally spill over the sides of planters, creating a soft and layered look that works especially well in elevated spaces. Hang it near a window, place it on a high shelf, or let its foliage fall gently from a cabinet to add depth and movement. Its versatile shape makes it easy to include in both modern and relaxed interiors.

Its stems gradually trail downward, creating a beautiful waterfall-like effect as they grow. It looks especially appealing in hanging planters, elevated pots, or on high shelves where the foliage can naturally spill over the edges. Its unusual form makes it an excellent choice for adding visual interest to smaller spaces and plant collections.
